personaOwnership.maskEncoding: L-mode PNG; 0=unassigned/transparent; 1-8=base direction order; 9-16=awake direction order.
personaOwnership.thresholdUse: Alpha >= 20 locates eight four-connected opaque pose-core seeds per row only; no source pixel is removed by alpha thresholding.
personaOwnership.ownershipRule: Every source pixel with nonzero alpha in the two authored rows is assigned to the nearest pose-core pixel by Euclidean distance; core pixels remain assigned to their own direction.
